=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh: 563
  Problem: `git ls-files -s -v -z` uses an invalid `-v` option. The `git ls-files` command does not support a `-v` flag (valid options include `-s`/`--stage`, `-z`, `-c`, `-d`, `-m`, `-o`, etc., but not `-v`).
  Why it fails at runtime: The command exits with an error like "error: unknown switch 'v'", raising `subprocess.CalledProcessError` instead of the expected `ValueError`. The test at line 711 asserts `"::error::Resolver scope check failed closed (ValueError)."` but the actual error would be `"::error::Resolver scope capture failed closed (CalledProcessError)."` because the capture action calls `merge_state()` first. The existing `index_state()` function at line 801 correctly uses `["git", "ls-files", "--stage", "-z"]` without `-v`.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Extend tests for safe index refreshes and unsafe staging" — the new resolver regression tests should execute and validate the resolver's behavior change.

The `main()` function at lines 781-806 lists 18 existing tests but omits all 5 new ones. CI workflows `.github/workflows/ci.yml:762`, `mark-stable.yml:360`, and `test-and-mark-stable.yml:4169` invoke this file directly via `python3 tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_retry_prelude_render.py`, which only executes tests listed in `main()`. The new tests are dead code that will never run in CI.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
